title: Global Cuisine, Culinary Heritage & Expressing Dietary Preferences Politely
objective: Mendiskusikan tradisi kuliner internasional, alergi makanan, preferensi vegetarian/halal, dan memesan menu secara spesifik.

theory.summary: Dalam konteks global, kemampuan mengekspresikan preferensi makanan dengan sopan sangat penting. Di level B1, Anda akan belajar cara menanyakan komposisi hidangan, menyampaikan alergi atau pembatasan diet, dan membuat permintaan khusus di restoran dengan bahasa yang halus dan profesional. Gunakan modal verbs seperti 'could' dan 'would' untuk kesopanan, serta frasa informatif seperti 'I have a dietary restriction' atau 'Does this contain...?' untuk komunikasi yang jelas.
rules: Gunakan 'Could you tell me...?' atau 'Would it be possible...?' untuk pertanyaan sopan: 'Could you tell me what ingredients are in this dish?' lebih formal daripada 'What's in this?'
Sampaikan alergi dengan jelas menggunakan 'I have a/an [adjective] allergy to...': 'I have a severe nut allergy' atau 'I'm allergic to shellfish' untuk memastikan keamanan
Gunakan 'Could I have...?' untuk permintaan modifikasi: 'Could I have the dressing on the side?' atau 'Could I have this without garlic, please?' menunjukkan kesopanan

Kosakata kuliner tingkat intermediate mencakup: savory (gurih), zesty (segar dan pedas), tender (empuk), simmer (memasak dengan api kecil), garnish (hiasan), marinate (merendam bumbu), bland (hambar), aromatic (harum)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan dalam Menyampaikan Alergi dan Preferensi
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering menggunakan bahasa yang terlalu langsung atau tidak cukup jelas saat menyampaikan pembatasan diet, yang bisa terdengar kasar atau menyebabkan kesalahpahaman berbahaya.
commonTrap.wrong: I don't eat meat. Take it out.
commonTrap.correct: I'm vegetarian. Could I have this dish without meat, please? Or would you recommend a vegetarian option?

dialogue.context: Sarah sedang makan malam di restoran Mediterranean bersama koleganya, Ahmad. Sarah memiliki alergi seafood dan Ahmad menjalankan diet halal. Mereka sedang memesan makanan kepada pelayan.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Good evening! Are you ready to order, or would you like a few more minutes?
lines.translation: Selamat malam! Apakah Anda siap memesan, atau Anda butuh waktu beberapa menit lagi?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: We're ready, thank you. Could you tell me what's in the seafood paella? I have a shellfish allergy.
lines.translation: Kami siap, terima kasih. Bisakah Anda jelaskan apa saja yang ada di seafood paella? Saya alergi kerang-kerangan.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: The paella contains mussels, prawns, and squid. But we also have a chicken and vegetable paella that's very popular.
lines.translation: Paella tersebut berisi kerang, udang, dan cumi. Tapi kami juga punya paella ayam dan sayuran yang sangat populer.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Perfect! I'll have the chicken paella, please. Could I have it without the bell peppers?
lines.translation: Sempurna! Saya akan pesan paella ayam. Bisakah saya minta tanpa paprika?

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.text: Excuse me, does your restaurant serve halal meat? It's important for my dietary requirements.
lines.translation: Permisi, apakah restoran Anda menyajikan daging halal? Ini penting untuk kebutuhan diet saya.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Yes, all our lamb and chicken dishes are prepared with halal-certified meat. I'd recommend our lamb tagine—it's very tender and aromatic.
lines.translation: Ya, semua hidangan domba dan ayam kami disiapkan dengan daging bersertifikat halal. Saya rekomendasikan lamb tagine kami—sangat empuk dan harum.

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.text: That sounds excellent. I'll have the lamb tagine. Could I have the couscous on the side instead of mixed in?
lines.translation: Kedengarannya bagus sekali. Saya akan pesan lamb tagine. Bisakah saya minta couscous-nya terpisah, bukan dicampur?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Absolutely, no problem at all. I'll make sure the kitchen notes both of your special requests.
lines.translation: Tentu saja, tidak masalah sama sekali. Saya akan pastikan dapur mencatat kedua permintaan khusus Anda.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berbicara dengan Mr. Khoirul, seorang AI tutor, dalam skenario roleplay di restoran fusion Asia. Mr. Khoirul berperan sebagai pelayan, dan Anda adalah tamu yang memiliki alergi kacang serta preferensi untuk makanan vegetarian. Latih cara menyampaikan kebutuhan diet Anda dengan sopan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good evening! Welcome to Fusion Garden. Have you dined with us before? Our menu features dishes from Thailand, Japan, and Vietnam.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good evening! No, this is my first time. The menu looks amazing. Could you help me with something? I'm vegetarian and I have a severe peanut allergy.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Of course! I'm glad you mentioned that. Many of our Thai dishes use peanuts, so I'll point out the safe options. Are you also avoiding other nuts, or just peanuts?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Just peanuts, thankfully. Other nuts are fine. Could you tell me which vegetarian dishes would be completely peanut-free?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Certainly! Our vegetable green curry is excellent and peanut-free. We also have a tofu teriyaki bowl and Vietnamese spring rolls with a tamarind sauce instead of peanut sauce. Would any of those interest you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The green curry sounds delicious! Could you tell me what vegetables are in it? And is it very spicy?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: It has bamboo shoots, bell peppers, Thai basil, and eggplant. The spice level is medium, but we can make it mild if you prefer. Would you like me to ask the kitchen to adjust it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Medium is perfect for me. I'll have the vegetable green curry, please. Could I have extra rice on the side? And just to confirm—no peanuts anywhere in the preparation?

quiz.question:
When asking about ingredients due to an allergy, which phrase is most appropriate?

A: What's in this?
B: I can't eat nuts.
C: ___
options: Tell me everything in this dish.
Could you tell me what this dish contains? I have a nut allergy.
Does this have nuts? I don't like them.
quiz.answer: Could you tell me what this dish contains? I have a nut allergy.
quiz.explanation: Pilihan ini paling tepat karena menggunakan 'Could you...' yang sopan, menjelaskan alasan spesifik (alergi, bukan preferensi), dan meminta informasi lengkap tentang komposisi hidangan. Ini memastikan komunikasi yang jelas dan aman.

quiz.question:
Which word best describes meat that is soft and easy to chew?

___ lamb fell apart with just a fork.
options: The zesty
The tender
The savory
quiz.explanation: 'Tender' adalah kata yang tepat untuk menggambarkan daging yang empuk dan mudah dikunyah. 'Zesty' menggambarkan rasa segar dan pedas, sementara 'savory' berarti gurih. Dalam konteks tekstur daging, 'tender' adalah pilihan yang benar.

quiz.question:
Complete the polite request for a menu modification:

___ the dressing on the side, please?
options: I want
Could I have
Give me
quiz.explanation: 'Could I have' adalah bentuk paling sopan untuk membuat permintaan di restoran. Modal verb 'could' menunjukkan kesopanan, berbeda dengan 'I want' atau 'Give me' yang terlalu langsung dan bisa terdengar kasar dalam konteks formal.

quiz.question:
What does 'simmer' mean in cooking?

The recipe says to ___ the sauce for 15 minutes.
options: boil rapidly at high temperature
cook gently at low heat
stir continuously while heating
quiz.explanation: 'Simmer' berarti memasak dengan api kecil, di mana cairan hampir mendidih tapi tidak sampai mendidih penuh. Ini adalah teknik memasak yang lembut untuk mengembangkan rasa tanpa mengurangi cairan terlalu cepat atau merusak bahan makanan.

quiz.question:
Which phrase correctly expresses a dietary restriction?

I follow a halal diet. ___
options: Does your restaurant use halal meat? It's important for my dietary requirements.
I only eat halal so change the menu for me.
You must cook halal food.
quiz.answer: Does your restaurant use halal meat? It's important for my dietary requirements.
quiz.explanation: Frasa ini sopan karena menggunakan pertanyaan, bukan perintah, dan menjelaskan pentingnya kebutuhan diet tanpa menuntut. Pilihan lain terlalu demanding atau tidak sopan untuk konteks komunikasi di restoran.
